observations: Photo 0 shows BIOS System Information: 64 GB DDR3 RAM at 1600 MHz, 4 active channels, 4 DIMMs populated on CPU1, 4 empty slots on CPU2, manufacture date 02/22/2014, ownership date 02/28/2014.
Photo 1 shows Processor 1 details: Intel Xeon E5-2670 v2 @ 2.50GHz, 10 cores, 30664 ID, 25600 kB L3 cache, HT supported, 64-bit technology.
Photo 2 shows the front of a Dell Precision T7610 tower with visible Dell logo, DVD drive, USB ports, and 'DELL PRECISION T7610' label on the side panel.
All photos have a watermark 'GIGAXYSAFE TECHNOLOGIES'.

claims.claim: This Dell Precision T7610 Tower comes equipped with 2x E5-2670 v2 processors
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show only one processor (CPU1) is populated; CPU2 slots are empty. Photo 1 confirms Processor 1 is E5-2670 v2, but no evidence of a second CPU.
The seller's text is cut off; no specific speed is stated. Photo 1 shows 2.50GHz base clock, but actual speed depends on load and turbo, which cannot be verified remotely.

risks.risk: Second CPU is not installed, despite seller's claim of 2x E5-2670 v2
risks.proof: Photo showing both CPU sockets populated with processors, or a BIOS screen confirming CPU2 is active.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as single-CPU system, which is significantly less valuable than dual-CPU.

risks.risk: System may not be fully functional or may have hidden hardware issues (e.g., RAM, power supply, cooling)
risks.proof: Video or photo of the system powering on, running a diagnostic, or showing all components operational.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-working or with unknown functionality, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Missing or non-functional storage drives (SATA/SAS slots are empty in BIOS)
risks.proof: Photo or video showing installed hard drives or SSDs, or confirmation of storage capacity and health.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having no storage, which is a major functional limitation.

proof_requests: Photo or video showing the second CPU installed and recognized in BIOS.
Photo or video of the system powering on and booting into an OS.
Photo or video showing installed storage drives (HDD/SSD) and their capacity.
Photo of the rear panel showing all ports and connections.
response.reason: The seller claims a dual-CPU system, but photos show only one CPU installed. Without proof of the second CPU and system functionality, the item cannot be priced accurately. The current evidence supports a single-CPU configuration, which is a major price determinant.
